newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt Nile Match profit up in 95/96.
newsitem.headline: Egypt Nile Match profit up in 95/96.

text.p: Nile Match and Prefabricated Houses profits rose slightly to 10.676 million pounds ($3.14 million) in the financial year 1995/96 from 10.267 million in the previous year, figures published on Sunday showed.

The firm said shareholders' portion of the profits was 6.689 million, or 3.34 pounds a share for 95/96. This is compared to 5.025 million pounds in the previous year, an equivalent of 2.5 pounds per share.
The state sold about 65 percent of Nile Match's two million shares to private investors in August at 27 pounds a share. The stock was traded on Sunday at 29.61 pounds.
Brokers had said Nile Match made unaudited net after-tax profits of 8.117 million pounds in the 1995/96 financial year against 8.929 million in 1994/5.
Turnover rose to 93.158 million pounds from 90.365 million in 95/96 and 94/95 respectively.
Brokers have reported turnover rose to 93.904 million pounds from 91.001 million.
The firm's reserves went up to 17.025 million pounds in 95/96 from 15.334 million in the previous year.
